import datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, statistics, subprocess, time
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); out=root/'target/medium-mixed-regression-20261017'; old=root/'target/arm64-kernel-adoption-20261017'

sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(pathlib.Path(job['pixels']))==job['pixel_sha256']
job_path=out/'control.job.json';job_path.write_text(json.dumps(job,indent=2)+'\n')
versions={'A':old/'baseline-benchmark','B':old/'tail-v2-benchmark'}
original=json.loads((old/'tail-v2-comparison/report.json').read_text())
assert sha(versions['A'])==original['executable_sha256']['baseline']
assert sha(versions['B'])==original['executable_sha256']['tail-v2']
ledger_path=old/'ledger.json'; ledger=json.loads(ledger_path.read_text());initial=ledger.copy()
scope={'purpose':'same-executable controls, reversed order, Medium mixed only; no retries or sampling growth','order':['A','B','B','A','A','B'],'per_process_timeout_seconds':4.5,'new_execution_limit_per_version_seconds':13,'aggregate_execution_limits_seconds':{'baseline':75,'tail-v2':60},'counts_per_version':{'processes':3,'first':3,'warmups':3,'measured':3},'initial_ledger':initial,'binary_sha256':{v:sha(p) for v,p in versions.items()}}
(out/'control-scope.json').write_text(json.dumps(scope,indent=2)+'\n')
def host():
    return {'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'load':os.getloadavg(),'thermal':subprocess.run(['pmset','-g','therm'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout,'power':subprocess.run(['pmset','-g','batt'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout}
records=[]
for index,v in enumerate(scope['order']):
    key='baseline' if v=='A' else 'tail-v2'
    remaining=min(scope['aggregate_execution_limits_seconds'][key]-ledger[key],13-(ledger[key]-initial[key]),4.5)
    assert remaining>0
    before=host(); start=time.monotonic(); path=out/f'control-{index}-{v}.json'
    try:
        with path.open('w') as stdout,(out/f'control-{index}-{v}.log').open('w') as stderr:
            p=subprocess.run([str(versions[v]),'_worker',str(job_path)],cwd=root,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,timeout=remaining)
    finally:
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start;ledger[key]+=elapsed;ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
    assert p.returncode==0,(index,v,p.returncode)
    data=json.loads(path.read_text())
    reference=next(c for c in original['cases'] if c['model']=='medium' and c['fixture']==job['fixture'])['baseline']['result']
    assert data['result']==reference,'Medium output changed'
    records.append({'index':index,'version':v,'before':before,'after':host(),'process_seconds':elapsed,'worker':data})
    (out/'control-report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':scope,'records':records,'final_ledger':ledger},indent=2)+'\n')
    print(index,v,'wall',data['samples_ms'],'CPU',data['process_cpu']['samples_ms'],'process',round(elapsed,3),flush=True)
for v in versions:
    rs=[r['worker'] for r in records if r['version']==v]
    print(v,'wall median',statistics.median([r['samples_ms'][0] for r in rs]),'CPU median',statistics.median([r['process_cpu']['samples_ms'][0] for r in rs]),flush=True)

limitations: One physical M4 with unpinned macOS scheduling; logical Rayon worker indices are not P/E core IDs.
Parallel stage work counters overlap wall phases; owner thread CPU excludes helper threads when nested kernels run.
One instrumented profile per recorded case; separate execution from ordinary samples; do not rescale profiles to medians.
Three fixed ordinary samples do not establish statistical significance or rule out host variation.
Historical controls, diagnostic instrumentation and final comparisons are separate source/executable/configuration records.
Acquisition, image decode, serialization and concurrent request throughput are outside ordinary predecoded-image latency.
